name: grep

test_list.description: Exclude ignored paths using repository and Polaris ignore rules.
Never emit more than max_results and set truncated when more matches exist.
Reject patterns violating the shared regex HIR/size guard.
Do not match files containing NUL bytes in the binary-detection prefix.
Return bounded partial results and mark truncation when the deadline expires.

output_description: Capped, ordered match results and explicit truncation metadata.
